traits.inflorescence.note: Wikipedia Hydrangea (read 2026-10-17): about 70 to 98 species; flowers in corymbs or panicles, mostly at stem tips; its lacecap and mophead forms are flat or domed corymb-like heads. Corymb ranked first on that basis, panicle as the lesser form.

traits.stamens.note: Flora of China vol. 8 p. 411, Hydrangea (read 2026-10-18): stamens (8 or) 10 (or 25), inserted on the disc. Flora of North America vol. 12, Hydrangea: stamens 10. Dendrology (2019) pp. 322-326 gives 8 to 10 for H. arborescens, H. aspera, H. macrophylla and H. paniculata. Stated for the genus in place of Hydrangeaceae's 4 to 100, which the family's many-stamened mock oranges widen.
